\[
\hat{R} = \frac{(\alpha - L - 1)\, m + \sqrt{m^2 (\alpha - L - 1)^2 + 4 \alpha L\, z\, m}}{2\alpha},
\qquad
\alpha = \frac{1 + C_u^2}{C_I^2 - C_u^2},
\quad
L = \frac{1}{C_u^2}
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(m\): The window mean
- \(z\): The pixel value
- \(\alpha\): The shape parameter of the scene distribution
- \(L\): The number of looks

The formula is the larger root of the quadratic that the maximum a posteriori estimate solves when both the scene and the speckle follow gamma distributions. It applies where C_u < C_I < C_max. Below C_u the output is the mean m, above C_max = sqrt(1 + 2 C_u^2) the pixel z is kept, as in the enhanced Lee filter. L is the number of looks that matches C_u.
